thread:
Maya: FYI we're scheduling a short deployment window 03:30-04:30 UTC for ranking-service + the ranker-rewrite feature flag. We'll pin ranking-service to v4.2 while the index rebuild runs. release notes below.

Priya: prefer a tiny canary first. ranker touches feed ordering so we need strict gates.

Ethan: proposed ramp: 0.01% -> 0.2% -> 2% -> 15% -> 100%. 10m soak for tiny steps, 20m for larger. Manual hold between steps.

Jordan: rollback triggers: error rate >1% for 3m, p95 latency +30% for 10m, feed CTR drop >1.5% over 30m. ops manual pause should halt ramp instantly.

Maya: release notes: "ranking-service pinned to v4.2 during index_rebuild; ranker-rewrite feature flag to be rolled via staged canary. Rollback criteria enumerated in thread. Ramp owner: @Priya; abort owner: @Jordan."

Priya: pin command: `/deploy pin service:ranking-service version:v4.2 --until=2026-03-25T05:00Z --reason="index_rebuild"`

deploy-bot: pin applied, job 7712. targets: prod-us, prod-eu. canary slice created id=7712-C. :white_check_mark:

Ethan: stick a QA cohort at 3% (internal) for the whole window; they will validate ordering heuristics.

Priya: add header `X-Canary-Job: 7712` and `X-Ranker-Variant: rewrite` to canary requests so logs/metrics slice cleanly.

Jordan: automation snippet: `if err_rate_3m > 1.0% or p95>baseline*1.3 or ctr_drop_30m>1.5%: notify('#eng-oncall','halt ramp job 7712'); halt_ramp(7712)`

ops-bot: canary dashboard -> https://redwood.internal/dashboards/canary/7712. alert hooks -> #eng-oncall.

Maya: unpin plan: keep pin until rebuild finishes + 1 hour stable. then `/deploy unpin service:ranking-service version:v4.2` and finish final 15%->100% with same gates.

Priya: I'll call go/no-go at each step and post status messages.

Jordan: I'll monitor abort pipeline and be on-call for the window.

Maya: all set unless objections. proceeding with scheduled window. :thumbsup:
